_doc: Interactive sandbox: a real browser you drive by hand, with the IAC HUD
attached so anything you do can be run as an operation and exported as a
PRIMARY USE -- REFRESHING AN EXPIRED LOGIN
1. The browser opens on the site below. Log in by hand.
2. Either press Exit in the HUD, or run the `save_state` operation
explicitly. Its path is prefilled from save_storage_state, so you
do not have to type it.
3. On exit the session is written to auth/session.json automatically.
Every pipeline pointing at that file picks it up on its next run.
A malformed or expired session file no longer blocks this: it is reported
and ignored, and the browser starts clean so you can log in and replace it.
The HUD's operation list is the same vocabulary the runner uses, so a
chain exported from here replays as-is through `python3 iac.py <plan>`.
headless MUST stay false -- the entire point is that a human drives it.
Recording is off by default so a login is not filmed; turn it on
deliberately if you want the session captured.

plan._why: Explicit save as well as the automatic one on close, so the session is on disk before anything else can go wrong during shutdown.

args.message: Sandbox session ended. Session state saved to auth/session.json
